modules.name: Contact Directory
modules.description: Lets residents see society contacts and tap to call them.

modules.name: Society Documents
modules.description: Lets the Society Manager upload documents that residents can view.

requirements.title: Contact directory with tap to call
requirements.description: When a contact is added, residents see it in the directory and can tap to call. Applies to both platforms; priority Must.

requirements.title: Society Manager uploads society documents
requirements.description: The Society Manager can upload a PDF or image up to 10 MB, and residents can then view it. Mobile platform; priority Must.

requirements.title: Log document deletions in activity log
requirements.description: When a document is deleted, it is removed from residents' view and the deletion is saved in the activity log. Applies to both platforms; priority Must.

rules.title: Document upload file type and size limit
rules.description: Uploaded documents must be a PDF or image of up to 10 MB.

rules.title: Residents have view-only access to documents
rules.description: Residents can only view society documents; uploading is done by the Society Manager.
